grammar.numbers: the gold line spikes up into the number (hook and every figure); a date or year drops a vertical marker at the right edge with the date on it
grammar.change: line runs flat at the old level, then steps to the new level at swapAtMs in the data's direction; dashed guide and value label at each level, the gap shaded
grammar.trend: the real points drawn as the line with every value printed, y-axis labelled at the data's low and high, x labels underneath
grammar.lenders: logo tile over a small blip on the line, neutral label; a chip at the right of the header when the stage is taken
grammar.captionPosition: fixed band under the chart, English line with a thin gold rule on SAFE.bottom

skinAxes.cover: the gold line draws a heartbeat and a big spike across the monitor, logo tile on white above, title under the chart
skinAxes.captions: white words, the current word glows and lifts, keywords gold
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; a line-chart monitor is the stage
skinAxes.transitions: the line redraws left to right for every beat; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: navy monitor, faint grid scrolling slowly, y-axis ticks, scanlines, gold glow
skinAxes.sound: voice + dings on stats and the change step, cue clicks
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
